description.fun: Spiritomb is 108 spirits, some of them ill-natured, bound to a cracked Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds some 500 years ago. The number 108 runs right through it: it weighs exactly 108 kg and was No. 108 in the Sinnoh Pokédex. That number seems to echo the 108 temptations of Buddhist tradition and the 108 demons freed from a stone tablet at the start of the Chinese novel Water Margin.
description.guide: Spiritomb is a Ghost- and Dark-type Pokémon made of 108 spirits bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for past misdeeds. It is rarely seen in the wild and does not evolve.
description.tagline: 108 mischievous spirits trapped in one cracked stone.
